sections.text_helper: Section 6.4.12 "RIFSC peripheral protection status register 5 (RIFSC_PPSR5)" in chapter 6 (Resource isolation framework security controller (RIFSC)), RM0486 Rev 4, page 256.
sections.section_content:
Address offset: 0xFC4
Reset value: 0x7DDE EF7F
Bits 31:0 PPEN{i + 160}: peripheral protection enable {i + 160} (i = 0 to 31)
0: SEC{i + 160}, PRIV{i + 160}, and RLOCK{i + 160} bits are not present.
1: SEC{i + 160}, PRIV{i + 160}, and RLOCK{i + 160} bits are present.

values.meaning: SEC{i + 160}, PRIV{i + 160}, and RLOCK{i + 160} bits are not present.
SEC{i + 160}, PRIV{i + 160}, and RLOCK{i + 160} bits are present.
